data.name: GrokVideoNode
data.description: Generate video from a prompt or an image

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: The model to use for video generation.

input_details.name: prompt
input_details.tooltip: Text description of the desired video. Optional for grok-imagine-video-1.5 when an input image is provided.

input_details.name: resolution
input_details.tooltip: The resolution of the output video. 1080p is only available for grok-imagine-video-1.5.

input_details.name: aspect_ratio
input_details.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the output video.

input_details.name: duration
input_details.tooltip: The duration of the output video in seconds.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed to determine if node should re-run; actual results are nondeterministic regardless of seed.

input_details.name: image
input_details.tooltip: Optional starting image. If omitted, the video is generated from the text prompt alone.
